papers.title: 1α,25-Dihydroxyvitamin D
papers.abstract: Oral implant osseointegration is delayed by hyperglycemia-generated oxidative stress (OS). Forkhead transcription factor 1 (FoxO1) is known to be viewed as a sensor to OS since reactive oxide species like H2O2 regulates its activity. We previously demonstrated that 1,25(OH)2D3 favored glucose homeostasis and implant osseointegration in diabetic rats. In this study, we investigated the role of FoxO1OB in the regulation process of 1,25(OH)2D3 on glycometabolism and bone metabolism. We show herein that, with the treatment of 1,25(OH)2D3, mice lacking FoxO1 in osteoblasts (FoxO1OB-/-) exhibited decreased serum glucose that was gradually elevated in untreated diabetic mice. An optimal increase of bone mass and bone-implant contact (BIC) was observed in 1,25(OH)2D3 treated FoxO1OB-/- mice after 2-month healing. Surprisingly, FoxO1OB-/- mice without 1,25(OH)2D3 treatment also showed an improvement on bone formation and BIC. Same effect could be found in the expression of bone-related markers Runx2, Osterix and BSP, which elevated in 1,25(OH)2D3 treated FoxO1OB-/- mice as compared to untreated WT mice. In addition, in vitro study showed that high glucose induced FoxO1 nuclear localization while the effect was ameliorated by 1,25(OH)2D3 treatment. These results suggest that FoxO1OB might be involved in the regulation of 1,25(OH)2D3 on glucose homeostasis and bone formation, and that FoxO1OB might act as a key modulator of the capacity of the skeleton regulating metabolic homeostasis. Our study also provides a new idea that a combination of systemic 1,25(OH)2D3 and local FoxO1 inhibitor may be a new approach to enhance implant osseointegration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究维生素D和FoxO1对糖尿病大鼠种植体骨整合的分子机制，与增材制造生物医学材料无关。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no porous structure design or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究1,25(OH)2D3通过FoxO1调控糖尿病大鼠种植体骨整合的机制。
summary_zh.method: 利用FoxO1OB-/-小鼠模型，检测血糖、骨量和骨-种植体接触。
summary_zh.result: FoxO1OB缺失联合1,25(OH)2D3治疗改善了骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 动物实验结合体外细胞研究。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the role of FoxO1 in osteoblasts in mediating the beneficial effects of 1,25(OH)2D3 on implant osseointegration under hyperglycemia.
summary_en.method: FoxO1OB-/- mice were treated with 1,25(OH)2D3 and assessed for serum glucose, bone mass, and bone-implant contact.
summary_en.result: Deletion of FoxO1 in osteoblasts combined with 1,25(OH)2D3 treatment improved osseointegration and bone formation.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal experiments with in vitro cell studies.

papers.title: Critical evaluation of the pulsed selective laser melting process when fabricating Ti64 parts using a range of particle size distributions
papers.first_author_affiliation: Industrial Engineering Department, College of Engineering, King Saud University, P.O. Box 800 Riyadh 11421, Saudi Arabia

corresponding_authors.name: Abdullah Yahia AlFaify
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Industrial Engineering Department, College of Engineering, King Saud University, P.O. Box 800 Riyadh 11421, Saudi Arabia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti64粉末粒径对脉冲选区激光熔化工艺的影响，但未涉及植入物设计或应力遮挡等生物力学问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses on process parameters and particle size effects on density and surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同粉末粒径对脉冲SLM工艺的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用不同粒径Ti64粉末进行脉冲SLM成形实验
summary_zh.result: 发现粒径影响致密度和表面粗糙度，优化粒径可改善质量
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度和粗糙度测量进行实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the influence of Ti64 powder particle size distribution on the pulsed selective laser melting process.
summary_en.method: Experimental investigation using different powder size fractions in p-SLM, followed by characterization of density and surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Particle size significantly affects part density and surface finish, with an optimal range identified for improved quality.
summary_en.validation: Validation through density measurements and surface roughness profilometry.
